## Frozen composition seams

Keep existing signatures compatible. Add `NoticeOptions` as optional third argument of `GameView.notify(message, error?, options?)` and forward the already implemented SessionEvents/notice-event metadata unchanged. No new saved fields or parsing message text to assign new channels. Untagged legacy calls may default to action; classify existing app system/export/graphics notifications explicitly at their call sites. Export serialization failure is persistence; import validation remains system/error as supplied by SessionEvents.

Add `GameView.presentationStep(state: GameState): void` for one active fixed-step advance, `GameView.threatCall(origin: Vec3, state: GameState): void` for a detached actual call, and `GameView.blockedAscent(visible: boolean): void` for the app's measured result. Internal HudView methods may match these; new helpers are module-local. Call presentationStep exactly once per completed `stepGame`, after state installation and event delivery, never from paint frequency, paused menu commands or arbitrary HUD refreshes. Use the existing `FIXED_SECONDS`; no catch-up on resume or per-frame simulation mutation.

App forwards only sound events with `source === "threat-call"` and a finite origin into threatCall; audio receives the same unchanged events. App owns the bounded sustained-ascent accumulator using already emitted ascent-sample. View reset/cancel/close/dispose seams clear the appropriate presentation state, without changing entry permission, writer exclusion, command acceptance or mouse capture. Exact additional internal signatures/constants return in handoff.

## Notice priority and lifecycle

One central notice at a time. Priority: persistence/reminder failure above current hazard, then action/system errors, then action success. System successes use a small separate status chip, so saving/exporting cannot displace danger. Keep the existing graphics-error surface, save status and persistent unsaved-session/export reminder visible and functional in all relevant screens. An import validation error must remain readable even though it is not a persistence failure.

Use explicit metadata and actual state for context. Do not introduce an unbounded queue. Prefer dropping suppressed low-priority transients; at most one latest pending item is permitted only if its relevance and age can be proved. Never replay stale gathering/craft/threat messages after session replacement, refuge entry or a changed situation. Preserve the accepted omission of redundant New-success text if appropriate, without using text matching as the new classification mechanism.

Action TTL starts around 4 active seconds and freezes while paused/in panels. Hazard/threat validity is state-bound, with a bounded display duration where appropriate; ongoing vital danger remains available in the hazard area. System-success chip may use about 3 wall-clock seconds so paused-menu successes clear. Persistence/error presentation must not require simulation ticking: retain about 12 seconds of wall time plus existing durable save/unsaved/graphics surfaces. These are trial values, reported and verified rather than silently declared polished.

While a panel is open, show an action result/refusal only in its existing inline feedback surface, with no duplicate toast. Lower-priority panel actions may remain inline while an independent persistence error is prominent. A result already shown inline must not replay as a toast on closing. Closing/switching/replacing must not expose a stale hidden inline result. Avoid stealing command/outcome focus when presenting a notice. Use role/status/live semantics without announcing unchanged text every frame. Root also observed the empty-storage exclusion sentence twice; omit just the redundant generic helper when the authoritative empty-set refusal already supplies it, using the preview's semantic state rather than rewriting the refusal.

## Encounter release and call direction

On actual transition to disengage, remove the stale warning/pursuit notice within one HUD refresh (no more than 0.5 active seconds). Outside a refuge, a short **Calls fading** cue may last about 2.5 active seconds. It describes behavior and must never promise safety. A new warn/pursue overrides it immediately. Idle, refuge, new session and disposal clear it. A loaded state may show truthful current-mode danger but must not invent a past call origin or a transition.

Root narrows the advisory off-screen arc: show a restrained **short-lived directional call cue** only from an actual emitted `threat-call`, for roughly 2.5–4 active seconds. Store a detached copy of the emission point, never consult current hunter.position to animate its bearing, and never label it as a current creature location. Current player/listener position and view yaw/pitch determine relative direction; use the same world-heading convention as audio and the view. This is an acoustic direction cue, not a world-space target projection, so it needs no new renderer/camera API.

A call can be audible through fog/occlusion and when its source is on screen. Do not suppress its accessible direction merely because a frustum/LOS test says the animal might be visible. That explicitly replaces the consultation's insufficient visibility rule. Show no animal silhouette, distance tracker, outline or exact world marker through solids. Use a compact edge/sector cue with an accessible direction equivalent, restrained motion and no fast flashing. Retain essential wildlife captions when audio is muted or opening captions are disabled. Existing threat text must also stop continuously printing live animal bearing; use a current last-call bearing only while valid, otherwise mode/action guidance without a direction. Suppress/clear call information in refuge, idle/disengage and across replacement. Pause freezes its active lifetime; a new call replaces the previous one.

## Air, ascent and contextual pulse

Consume **airSupply(state)** directly. Healthy powered craft shows its registry hull label + air; refuge and surface show their true source; finite emergency air shows its actual seconds; suit air shows current remaining seconds from the shared drain helper. Do not add supplies, show suit seconds as craft reserve or label the 180-second full-tank rating as current air. Use actual source precedence even when piloted craft and refuge overlap. Change the small air label on the actual first exposure transition; retain the percentage and critical oxygen warning. Disabled/depleted craft at the surface/refuge must not retain a misleading emergency-only air label. No auto-surface, vertical correction or physiology changes.

For blocked ascent, consume each fixed-step ascent-sample once. Require sustained upward request with substantial solid-limited rise and near-zero actual upward progress; a starting trial is 0.45 s, actual rise under 10% of requested and solid-limited rise over half of requested, with a numerical epsilon. Calibrate against the recorded rib and genuine overhang cases. Surface-limited motion must not produce **Blocked above**. Reset on absent/released request, meaningful progress, actor/mode change, pause/panel, replacement and graphics interruption. No timer in GameState, hidden simulation history, input replay or second collision query. Do not call a normal slide or terrain height correction a ceiling. The existing surface cue remains distinct.

Keep pulse cost/actual selected-cell result discoverable in Hold. Show compact HUD pulse availability/cost during a real threat or active distraction; avoid a permanent paragraph across calm exploration. Preserve free quiet/cover/retreat guidance and do not imply a mandatory charged item. Read the existing distractionPreview; no remote charge, hidden debit or new ability.
